Here, by combining density functional theory with Metropolis Monte Carlo methods, we discovered that suff icient stabilization in the $\mathrm{R u O}_{2}$ ！lattice could be achieved with less than 50 at.% of Ir, and that Ir in the first subsurface layer plays a critical role. By effectively dispersing Ir dopants within the $\mathrm{R u O}_{2}$ lattice, we demonstrated an Ir:Ru atomic ratio of only 1:6that exhibited exceptional stability for over 1,5o0 h of continuous water electrolysis at 2 A $\mathrm{cm}^{-2}$ .Our $\mathrm{Ru_{6}IrO_{x}}$ catalyst has the potential to reduce Ir loading by 80% compared with current commercial PEM water electrolysers,and its stability was further validated under industrial testing conditions in a 25-cm2 PEM electrolyser.
 When Ir content was further increased to 14 at.%, the $\mathsf{R u}_{6}\mathsf{I r O}_{3}$ 3became stable enough to retain the potential though the 1,5o0-h test oa  s $2.3–2.8\mu\mathrm{V}\mathrm{h}^{-1}$  eee e e ee r eere r rre see e re $\mathrm{Ru_{6}IrO}$ xmaintained stable voltage over the testing period, while $\mathrm{RuO}_{2}$ exhibited rapid deactivation (Supplementary Fig.19).Given the supreme durability, it was not surprising that Ru dissolution plateaued at less than one-third the amount observed for $\mathrm{R u}_{12}\mathrm{I r O}_{x}$ , and Ir dissolution was barely detectable. This minimal dissolution, combined with the well-preserved structure and composition observed in the post-operation analysis (Supplementary Fig. 20 and Supplementary Table 8), demonstrated the superior structure durability and resistance of $\mathrm{{^{\prime}R u_{6}I r O_{3}}}$ to the highly acidic and oxidative environment. Stable performance of $\mathrm{{\bf{\sf{I r O}}}}$ xand $\mathrm{I r O}_{2}\mathrm{a t}2\mathrm{A}\mathrm{c m}^{-2}$ (Supplementary Figs.2l and 22) further supports the stabilizing effect of higher Ir content.
 To validate the outstanding durability of $\mathrm{{\sf{R u}}}_{6}\mathrm{{\sf{I r O}}}_{x}$ in a larger PEM electrolyser and under elevated temperature operation, our collaborators at De Nora Tech applied this catalyst to an anode in a 25-cm2 PEM water electrolyser (Fig.4a) following their standard testing protocols (Methods).
